$comment: Contract for the RetireQuestion server-side command (AD-003, AD-122). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_RetireQuestion
customApi.description: Dates out the current version of a question and creates no successor, so it stops being asked while the answers it holds keep resolving. Refuses the question codes compiled logic depends on. Enforces Edit on question.retire and writes an immutable Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: QuestionId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_question to retire.

requestParameters.name: EffectiveTo
requestParameters.description: Optional yyyy-MM-dd. Absent is today. May not be in the past.

requestParameters.name: Reason
requestParameters.description: Why the question is no longer asked. Required and recorded on the Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same result.

responseProperties.name: RetiredVersionId
responseProperties.description: Id of the al_questionversion dated out.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when an optimistic-concurrency conflict was detected.
